summary: Trivial __thiscall byte-flag setter: copies the incoming byte parameter a2 into the byte field at offset 0x25 of this and returns the stored value. Unconditional write, no guards, globals, or callees. Structurally a twin of ByteFieldSetter (00497250), which writes the same offset.

local_names.result: return value holding the stored byte

operations.description: Copy the incoming byte parameter a2 into the local result value.
Store a2 into the byte field at offset 0x25 of this (this[0x25]).
Return the stored byte value (result == a2).

unresolved: Semantic role of the byte field at offset 0x25 (state flag vs. mode selector) is not determinable from this function alone; it is written unconditionally and read elsewhere.
No callers are recorded in the packet, so the object type and the purpose of the flag write are unknown.
